products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory founded in 2020 and operating as the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). The institute describes itself as a leading global scientific research center, and its public-facing work centers on the Falcon family of open-source large language models, which it releases under the Apache 2.0 license with a stated aim of making advanced AI accessible broadly. TII has also launched the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit body dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.

The Falcon model family spans a range of scales and architectures. Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, was described as the first open-source LLM of its kind released with weights for both research and commercial use. Falcon 180B scales to 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens and has appeared at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models. The Falcon 2 series introduced multimodal and multilingual capabilities, with the 11B model described as outperforming Meta's Llama 3 8B and performing on par with Google's Gemma 7B as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. More recent additions include Falcon-H1, a hybrid model combining Transformer and Mamba architectures, Falcon-E, Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and its dialects, Falcon Mamba 7B as the first open-source State Space Language Model, and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model combining vision and language capabilities.

The site's held facts classify TII as a non-profit government laboratory. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the organization.
